{"body":"  induction n generalizing a b with
  | zero => simp [walk]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [walk]
      have h := ih (a + 2) (b + 1)
      constructor
      · simpa [Int.add_sub, Int.mul_add, Int.mul_comm, Int.mul_left_comm, Int.mul_assoc] using h.1
      · exact le_trans (by omega) h.2"}
